projects.name: 有据 · 生活决策审议台
projects.subtitle: 从经验材料到可追溯的生活决策
projects.subtitleEn: From collected experience to traceable decisions
projects.description: 识别经验中的共识、分歧与适用条件，结合个人约束比较方案，由用户选择并导出决策卡。
projects.descriptionEn: Compare options against personal constraints using consensus, disagreement and applicability from collected experiences; the user chooses and exports a decision card.
projects.context: 经验很多，但哪些适合自己、相反意见如何权衡，往往不清楚。
projects.contextEn: Collected experiences do not make it clear which advice fits or how conflicting views should be weighed.
approach: 区分硬约束、偏好与待核实信息，明确标出方案冲突
保留材料依据、反方意见与行动前核实清单
approachEn: Separate hard constraints, preferences and unknowns; flag conflicting options.
Keep supporting material, opposing views and a pre-action verification checklist.
projects.result: 川西旅行与养猫家庭扫地机器人双场景 Demo；使用原创模拟资料，不接入实时搜索或电商价格。
projects.resultEn: Two demos: Western Sichuan travel and robot vacuums for cat-owning households. Uses original simulated material, not live search or e-commerce prices.
projects.demoNote: 先在首页选场景；推荐从未替用户自动做决定。扫地机器人场景的评论是演示样本，比价价格需手动输入。
projects.demoNoteEn: Choose either scenario on the homepage. Recommendations never make the final choice for the user. Product comments are simulated and comparison prices are entered manually.

projects.name: LLM 效果评估体系（creative-eval）
projects.description: 用评分锚点评估剧本质量，再以人工金标与重复评分检查裁判的一致性和稳定性。
projects.descriptionEn: Score scripts against anchored criteria, then check judge agreement and stability using human-labeled references and repeated runs.
projects.subtitle: 短剧剧本的五维评分与裁判校验
projects.subtitleEn: Five-dimension script scoring and judge validation
projects.context: 主观评审难以复现，也难以比较不同版本。
projects.contextEn: Subjective reviews are hard to reproduce or use for version comparison.
approach: 为钩子、人物动机、冲突、节奏与爽点设置评分锚点
用人工金标和三次重复评分，分别检查一致性与稳定性
approachEn: Anchor scores for hook, motivation, conflict, pacing and payoff.
Check agreement against human labels and stability across three repeated runs.
projects.result: 第一版评测体系；用于辅助筛选与版本比较，不替代人工终审。Demo 展示第二版 llm-output-eval。
projects.resultEn: The first evaluation framework supports screening and version comparison, not final human review. The demo presents its successor, llm-output-eval.
projects.demoNote: Demo 以第二版 llm-output-eval 呈现

projects.name: llm-output-eval
projects.subtitle: 有原文证据的长文本评测与版本对比
projects.subtitleEn: Evidence-backed text evaluation and version comparison
projects.description: 逐维评分并附原文证据，重复评测比较 Prompt 版本，将低分案例导出为 CSV。自带 API Key，可运行真实评测。
projects.descriptionEn: Score each dimension with source-text evidence, compare prompt versions across repeated runs, and export low-scoring cases to CSV. Bring an API key to run live evaluations.
projects.context: 需要比较生成版本的质量，同时确认打分器本身可靠。
projects.contextEn: Version comparison requires both useful quality scores and a calibrated judge.
approach: 每个分数附原文证据，并用人工金标校验裁判
重复运行两版 Prompt，比较均值与波动，汇总低分案例
approachEn: Attach source-text evidence and calibrate the judge against human labels.
Run both prompt versions repeatedly, compare averages and variation, and collect low-scoring cases.
projects.result: 适合辅助质量排序与版本比较；单次整数评分仍存在波动。API Key 仅保存在浏览器。
projects.resultEn: Supports quality ranking and version comparison; individual integer scores still vary. API keys remain in the browser.

projects.name: LLM 效果评估体系（filing-eval）
projects.description: 将摘要拆成原子断言，回原文核查支持、矛盾或无依据，并测试误报与提示注入。
projects.descriptionEn: Split summaries into atomic claims, check whether the source supports, contradicts or leaves them ungrounded, and test false positives and prompt injection.
projects.subtitle: 逐条核查公告摘要的事实依据
projects.subtitleEn: Claim-level fact checking for filing summaries
projects.context: 公告摘要可能添加原文没有的数字或因果关系。
projects.contextEn: Filing summaries can add numbers or causal claims absent from the source.
approach: 逐条断言回溯原文证据
用错误、正确与注入样本检查检出能力和误报
approachEn: Trace each claim to source evidence.
Test detection and false positives using erroneous, correct and injected samples.
projects.result: 样本集检出 11/11，误报 0/4，注入防护 5/5；结果仅对应当前测试样本。
projects.resultEn: On the test set: 11/11 errors detected, 0/4 false positives and 5/5 injection defenses passed. Results apply to these samples only.

projects.subtitleEn: Simulate bankroll paths and assess downside risk
projects.description: 输入资金、买入、胜率与方差，模拟资金路径、破产概率和最大回撤；用解析解交叉检查模拟结果。
projects.descriptionEn: Enter bankroll, buy-in, win rate and variance to simulate bankroll paths, bust probability and drawdown; cross-check the simulation against an analytical solution.

projects.name: 扑克期望值计算器（poker-ev-calculator）
projects.subtitle: 比较弃牌、跟注与加注的期望收益
projects.subtitleEn: Compare the expected value of folding, calling and raising
projects.description: 结合手牌强度与对手行为比较三种行动的 EV；加注按被跟注后的胜率修正，并用敏感性分析找出决策切换点。
projects.descriptionEn: Compare action EVs using hand strength and opponent behavior; adjust raise EV for equity after being called and use sensitivity analysis to locate decision thresholds.
metrics: AA 加注 EV +42.50 最优
平衡强度 50：高于它加注都成立
metricsEn: AA raise EV +42.50, the best line

projects.name: Growth Experiment Lab
projects.subtitle: 从实验设计到结果解读的决策工具
projects.subtitleEn: A decision tool from experiment design to interpretation
projects.description: 计算 A/B 实验样本量，模拟提前停止带来的误判，并将结果区间折算为增量收入。全部计算在浏览器完成。
projects.descriptionEn: Calculate A/B test sample sizes, simulate errors from early stopping, and translate result intervals into incremental revenue. All calculations run in the browser.
projects.context: 实验前要确定样本量，实验中要控制误判，实验后要解释收益。
projects.contextEn: Determine sample size before a test, control errors during it, and interpret business value afterward.
approach: 计算样本量与实验时长，模拟不同检查策略的假阳性风险
输出置信区间，并折算保守与乐观的增量收入
approachEn: Calculate sample size and duration; simulate false-positive risk under different checking strategies.
Report confidence intervals and translate them into conservative and optimistic revenue estimates.
projects.result: 本地运行的实验决策 Demo，不上传数据；模拟结果用于说明统计风险，不代表业务实验收益。
projects.resultEn: A local experiment-decision demo that uploads no data. Simulation results illustrate statistical risk, not business experiment returns.

projects.name: Pricing Model Sim
projects.subtitle: 比较三种付费机制的 LTV 与回本周期
projects.subtitleEn: Compare LTV and payback across three pricing mechanisms
projects.description: 调整留存与价格，比较单次解锁、订阅和混合机制的 12 个月收益，并通过敏感性分析找出机制切换点。
projects.descriptionEn: Adjust retention and pricing to compare 12-month returns from pay-per-unlock, subscription and hybrid models; use sensitivity analysis to identify switch-over points.
projects.context: 不同付费机制的收益取决于留存、转化与价格，不能只比较收入总额。
projects.contextEn: Mechanism returns depend on retention, conversion and price, not just total revenue.
approach: 用同一留存曲线比较三种机制的 LTV 与回本周期
扫描价格、转化等参数，找出最优机制变化的条件
approachEn: Compare LTV and payback across three mechanisms using one retention curve.
Sweep pricing and conversion parameters to find where the preferred mechanism changes.
projects.result: 提供四个合成案例与校验脚本；用于机制比较，不接入真实业务数据。
projects.resultEn: Includes four synthetic cases and validation scripts; compares mechanisms without connecting to real business data.

projects.name: Bundle Lab
projects.subtitle: 从订单共现中发现套餐机会
projects.subtitleEn: Discover bundle opportunities from co-purchased items
projects.description: 从订单中识别常购组合，模拟折扣与采纳率对客单和毛利的影响，导出套餐建议及收益边界。
projects.descriptionEn: Identify frequently co-purchased items, simulate how discount and adoption affect basket size and margin, and export bundle recommendations and profit boundaries.
projects.context: 商品经常一起购买，不等于组合成套餐后一定赚钱。
projects.contextEn: Frequently co-purchased items are not necessarily profitable as a discounted bundle.
approach: 对比订单结构，发现共购组合并进行召回校验
模拟折扣与采纳率，计算毛利变化和盈亏平衡点
approachEn: Compare order profiles, discover co-purchased combinations and check recall.
Simulate discount and adoption to calculate margin changes and break-even points.
projects.result: 浏览器端分析工具，使用合成数据演示；不接平台 API，不做在线推荐或库存管理。
projects.resultEn: A browser-based analysis tool demonstrated with synthetic data; no platform API, live recommendation or inventory management.

projects.name: 留学咨询内容矩阵
projects.description: 按国家、专业与预算组织垂类账号，通过 KOL 分发与咨询转化链路获取高意向线索。
projects.descriptionEn: Organize accounts by country, major and budget, using KOL distribution and consultation funnels to acquire high-intent leads.
projects.subtitle: 垂类内容矩阵与线索转化
projects.subtitleEn: Vertical content distribution and lead conversion
projects.context: 留学咨询需要降低对付费流量的依赖。
projects.contextEn: Study-abroad consulting needs to reduce dependence on paid acquisition.
approach: 按用户需求拆分垂类账号，统一选题与转化链路
通过 KOL 合作扩大内容分发
approachEn: Segment accounts by user needs, with coordinated topics and conversion funnels.
Expand distribution through KOL partnerships.
projects.result: 40+ 账号、10 万+ 粉丝，月均 100+ 高意向线索，CPL 降低 30%。
projects.resultEn: 40+ accounts, 100k+ followers, 100+ high-intent leads per month and 30% lower CPL.

languageEn: English (working language; 5 years in the UK)

about.body: 本科在布里斯托读电子电气工程，硕士在伦敦大学学院读金融工程。两段训练教的是同一件事：把模糊的问题变成可以计算的问题。
about.bodyEn: I studied Electronic and Electrical Engineering at Bristol and Financial Engineering at UCL. Both taught the same skill: turning a vague question into a computable one.
about.body2: 但算清楚一个问题之后，我更想知道的是人会怎么用它。产品经理这个岗位吸引我的地方，是它站在「能做什么」和「有人需要什么」的交界处。工程给你手段，用户给你理由，而判断哪些理由值得被满足，是这份工作真正的内容。我喜欢自己的判断能被验证：定义一个问题，把方案推上线，看数据回来说它对不对。这个循环短的时候，人学得最快。
about.body2En: But once a problem is worked out, what I want to know is how people will use it. What draws me to product is that it sits where "what can be built" meets "what someone needs". Engineering gives you the means, users give you the reasons, and deciding which reasons deserve to be met is the real substance of the job. I like having my judgement tested: define a problem, ship the solution, let the data say whether it was right. The shorter that loop, the faster you learn.

principles.dz: 多数做不下去的需求，是因为一开始没说清要解决什么。我习惯先把问题写成一句话，写不出来就说明还没想明白。
principles.de: Most stalled requests were never clearly stated. I write the problem as one sentence first; if I cannot, it is not ready.

principles.en: A metric needs a failure condition
principles.dz: 定指标的时候同时定清楚：什么情况算没达到。没有失败条件的指标只是装饰。
principles.de: When setting a metric, also define what counts as missing it. A metric without a failure condition is decoration.

principles.en: Do it yourself when you can
principles.dz: 写需求之前先把流程亲自走一遍。走一遍才知道哪一步是多余的、哪一句话会被理解错。
principles.de: Before writing a spec, walk the flow myself. Only then do I find which step is redundant and which sentence will be misread.

about.body3: 选 AI 方向，是因为这一轮技术把「能做什么」的边界推得比「该做什么」快得多。模型的能力是充裕的，稀缺的是把它放进一个真实场景、让它稳定解决一个具体问题的判断。这是产品经理的活，而且是现在最值得干的那一份。
about.body3En: I chose AI because this wave has pushed "what can be built" far ahead of "what should be built". Model capability is abundant. What is scarce is the judgement to put it into a real scenario and have it solve one concrete problem reliably. That is product work, and right now it is the product work most worth doing.

colophon.zh: 这个站是手写的：一个 index.html、一个 style.css、一个 app.js，加一份 data.json 当数据层。没有框架、没有构建步骤、没有依赖——改一行字就是改一行字。四个配色主题是真的四套 CSS 变量，不是滤镜。
colophon.en: This site is hand-written: one index.html, one style.css, one app.js, plus a data.json as the data layer. No framework, no build step, no dependencies — a text change is a text change. The four themes are four real sets of CSS variables, not a filter.
colophon.zh2: 字体用了 Inter / Noto Serif SC / JetBrains Mono。动画尽量用 CSS 而不是 JS，能省一帧是一帧。
colophon.en2: Type is set in Inter, Noto Serif SC and JetBrains Mono. Animations prefer CSS over JS — one frame saved is one frame saved.

items.en: Capability is abundant, judgement is scarce
items.dz: 模型能做的事已经远多于产品里用上的事。今天多数 AI 产品的瓶颈不在模型，在有没有人把它放进一个真实场景，定义清楚它要解决的具体问题。这是产品的活，不是算法的活。
items.de: Models can already do far more than products make use of. The bottleneck in most AI products today is not the model. It is whether someone has placed it in a real scenario and defined the specific problem it must solve. That is product work, not algorithm work.
items.refLabel: YouTube · Andrej Karpathy, Software in the Era of AI (2025)

items.dz: 一个 AI 功能「好不好」，不能靠感觉。我倾向于先把评测标准建出来再谈效果。标准本身就是产品的一部分，它决定了团队朝哪个方向优化，也决定了上线之后谁来说「够了」。
items.de: Whether an AI feature is "good" cannot rest on feel. I prefer to build the evaluation standard before discussing results. The standard is part of the product: it decides which direction the team optimises toward, and who gets to say "enough" after launch.

items.zh: 接下来十年是 Agent 的十年，不是 Agent 的一年
items.en: The decade of agents, not the year
items.dz: 自动驾驶从演示到落地用了十几年，Agent 也一样。真正有价值的不是全自动的炫技，是让人能调节自主程度、在关键节点快速验证的「半自动」产品。做这类产品，交互设计和验证效率比模型能力更重要。
items.de: Self-driving took over a decade from demo to deployment, and agents will follow the same arc. The value is not in fully autonomous showpieces but in "partially autonomous" products where people can dial autonomy up or down and verify quickly at key points. For such products, interaction design and verification speed matter more than raw model capability.
items.refLabel: Hamel Husain · Your AI Product Needs Evals

items.zh: To C 看留存，To B 看替换成本
items.en: Consumer AI is about retention, enterprise AI is about switching cost
items.dz: 消费端的 AI 产品，新鲜感过后拼的还是留存：用户愿不愿意每天回来。企业端的关键是替换成本：AI 方案比旧流程好多少，才值得客户承担切换的代价。两边都不是「有 AI」就赢，是「AI 让哪个数字变了」才赢。
items.de: Once novelty fades, consumer AI competes on retention: will people come back every day. On the enterprise side the question is switching cost: how much better than the old process must the AI solution be for a customer to bear the cost of change. Neither side wins by "having AI". They win by "which number AI moved".
